calculation_handling.description: Minimum lot area in the R zone is the numerical value after the letter "a" in the lot's zone label (square metres), when the label has an "a" value.
calculation_handling.gaps: Condition keyed as a presence test only (labelled(a)); no lot_condition token applies to a presence test.

calculation_handling.description: Where the zone label has no "a" value, the minimum lot area (square metres) is the required minimum lot frontage multiplied by 30 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: required_lot_frontage_m is the required (label f / zone) frontage, not the measured frontage, per the clause wording "required minimum lot frontage". If no required frontage resolves for the lot, the result is not_evaluated.

10.10.30.10(1).explanation: In the R zone the smallest lot allowed is set by the zone label on the Zoning By-law Map: if the label has an "a" number, that number is the minimum lot area in square metres; if not, the minimum lot area is the required minimum lot frontage times 30 metres.
